name: Rehman Dakait
real_life_parallel: Sardar Abdul Rehman Baloch — real Lyari don (born 1979, killed 2009)

biography.background: Born Sardar Abdul Rehman Baloch. Son of Mohammad Daddal (Babu Dakait), from whom he inherited criminal foundations. Transformed fragmented Lyari gangs into Peoples' Aman Committee (PAC) — political-criminal hybrid with PPP patronage. Killed in police encounter 2009.
biography.criminal_enterprise: Extortion, arms trafficking, political violence, FICN distribution through Karachi network
biography.political_relations: PPP patronage through Jamali; PAC as vote bank muscle
biography.film_1_role: Primary criminal adversary; Hamza infiltration target; killed midpoint
biography.film_2_role: Referenced as predecessor; Uzair succession context

risk_profile.description: High risk acceptance; violent lifestyle; expects violent death

intelligence_signature.communications: Mix of encrypted mobile and courier-based for sensitive coordination
intelligence_signature.pattern: Movement correlates with political events and territorial disputes
